exposure: High vs. low urine protein/creatinine ratio
high urine protein/creatinine ratio (UPCI) at admission
Conservative treatment for preeclampsia with severe features
conservative treatment for preeclampsia with severe features
cohort: 100 pregnant women with preeclampsia with severe features at 23-34 weeks gestation
finding: While high urine protein/creatinine ratio at admission was associated with shorter pregnancy prolongation duration, maternal and fetal outcomes did not significantly differ between those with shorter and longer prolongation.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in cesarean section rates between groups with different lengths of pregnancy prolongation.
